Homelab 1.6.4 — First Release

Forked from an open-source Homelab client with the following additions:

New Features

- **New Home Dashboard**: system health (CPU / memory / disk temperature), Docker containers, and qBittorrent cards with 10-second auto-refresh
- **CloudSaver Media Module**: poster search, one-tap transfer, auto-trigger plugins after watching, and auto re-login on JWT expiry
- **OpenList player powered by open-source VLCKit**: MKV/AVI and more formats, offline cache, and Picture-in-Picture
- **Arcane Interactive Terminal** (open-source SwiftTerm) with container images/statistics and logs
- **Enhanced qBittorrent details**: Tracker and rate-limit management
- **One-tap LAN vs. remote network mode**, bulk host replacement in Settings, and external subtitles
- Liquid Glass visual polish across OpenList, Arcane, qB, and CloudSaver

> Note: IPA is signed with a free Apple ID (development profile, expires 2026-08-12). Refresh via SideStore/AltStore after expiry.

---

Homelab 1.6.4 — 首个正式发布

本项目 fork 自开源 Homelab 客户端，在此基础上新增了以下功能：

新增功能

- **全新首页仪表盘**：系统健康（CPU/内存/磁盘温度）、Docker 容器、qBittorrent 卡片，10 秒自动刷新
- **CloudSaver 影视模块**：海报搜索、一键转存、看完即触发插件/运行、JWT 过期自动重登
- **OpenList 播放器升级为开源 VLCKit**：支持 MKV/AVI 等多格式、离线缓存与画中画
- **Arcane 交互式终端**（开源 SwiftTerm）：容器镜像/统计、日志查看
- **qBittorrent 详情增强**：Tracker 与限速管理
- **一键切换局域网/远程网络访问模式**、设置中批量替换主机地址、外挂字幕
- Liquid Glass 视觉打磨（OpenList/Arcane/qB/CloudSaver）

> 注意：IPA 使用免费 Apple ID 签名（development profile，2026-08-12 到期），到期后请通过 SideStore/AltStore 刷新。
